historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED pending exact session handle, privilege vocabulary/scope, authorization, readback and rollback.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Active Session is inventory and Close Session is termination; neither defines privilege mutation.

original_test_intent: Change the effective privilege of one dedicated BMC test session and verify exact scope, access behavior and restoration.
original_method: Do not invent a privilege command; require session/handle semantics, allowed levels, security approval, independent recovery, readback and rollback.
manual_activity: Vendor/security owner defines the exact session scope and privilege transition; operator validates dedicated target and independent admin recovery.

command_applicability.command_recommendation: None until the exact vendor method and rollback are approved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: On a dedicated session, capture baseline, apply one approved privilege level, read back effective scope, exercise bounded access, restore and verify audit state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds missing security/write contract without editing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only review cannot replace privilege-change coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong handle can escalate another operator or remove recovery access.

project_override_considerations: Any API must affect only the same dedicated session and provide equivalent effective-privilege readback and rollback.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: A security-critical write is named, but Procedure and Criteria are entirely TBD and log clearing would erase authorization/audit evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Session target, privilege semantics and rollback define the core operation and blast radius; they cannot be guessed as ordinary inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents undefined privilege escalation or lockout and preserves the actual write/readback/restore objective.
independent_technical_reasoning: Session privilege changes can affect only the current session or persistent account/channel policy depending on implementation. Because that distinction and the target handle are absent, any command could alter the wrong security principal; engineer/security decision is required.
